title: finding(fields): the readonly `PasswordField` widget draws the mask for an EMPTY value too — a credential that was never set reads like a set one, the defect objectui#8678 fixed in the cell renderer
body: Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named landing site, read from source with a lit control. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the objectui#8678 dev report (PR objectui#10529). The dev reported it as class a, and the seat re-read it at source on objectui `origin/main` `e0f8202`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here. ## The defect `packages/fields/src/widgets/PasswordField.tsx:16-17`: `if (readonly) { return ••••••••; }`. The branch never reads `value`. So `null`, `undefined` and `''` draw exactly the mask a set credential draws. The widget is published: the `password` widget entry (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:3970`) lazy-loads it, and the barrel re-exports it (`:4470`). This is the defect objectui#8678 fixed on the cell path. `MaskedCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:3364-3367`) draws `` for an empty value and the mask only for a set one. Its docblock cites the platform's read contract: `@objectstack/spec`'s `SECRET_MASK` says an unset credential "reads back `null` instead, never this mask", so a console can show "configured" against "not configured". The readonly widget still throws that distinction away. **Reach, as a lead (⛔ not measured by the seat):** any form or detail surface that renders a `password` field through the widget with `readonly` set. ## Direction (for triage, not a ruling) The cell's shape: the empty predicate the cell uses, and the mask only for a present value. ⛔ The value is never printed. ⛔ No weaker mask for a set value. ## Dedupe Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: - `readonly PasswordField shows bullets mask for empty null value same as set password` ⇒ objectui#8678 (closed; the origin card, the four CELL renderers, not the widget), objectui#5322 (closed; the unregistered `field:password` widget in clear text) and objectui#4221 (closed; inline edit writing the mask back). None covers the readonly widget's empty value, and the hits show the instrument is lit. Dedupe words: `PasswordField readonly empty mask` · `password widget null bullets` · `readonly credential not configured` · `SECRET_MASK unset widget`
